decisionsTitle: «Note interne» first on the registration's page, and a note from a row of the list (amending §777 and §847)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, from his phone:** "de asemenea, trebuie sa pot adauga comentarii direct de aici" (the registrations list), and "si pe pagina persoanei, comentariile trebuie sa apara cumva mai sus. Adica partea asta de note interne trebuie sa fie prima".

**Decision.** Two changes to §777's internal notes, nothing else of them; the first also amends §847, whose order of the registration page's cards had «Note interne» after «Emailuri» and now has it first (the test that pins §847's order is edited to match).

1. **The card stands first.** On a registration's page «Note interne» is the first card, right under the heading block (the name, the state, the address line, the page's own alerts) and above «Ce îi spui», the verbs and every other card. It is open by itself when the registration has at least one live note, so the comments are read without a press; with no note it stays closed and its closed line says «nicio notă». It still opens after its own save or delete and for the `#note-interne` link. The fold says why it opens in its own words: `fold.ts` gets one more reason, `holds` (the fold holds words somebody left for the reader), beside `refused`, `saved`, `attention`, `inUse` and `primary` — no second mechanism. A role that may not keep notes still gets no card and no read: the page asks the role before the read and the service refuses again.

2. **A note from a row of the list.** For a role that may keep notes (the Organizer, the Administrator, the Superadministrator) every row of the registrations list carries «Adaugă o notă» in the name cell, beside the notes marker when the row has notes, alone when it has none, at least 44 pixels high, its accessible name naming the person. Pressing it opens a dialog over the list: the person's name in its title, the card's one-line help (who sees the notes; no health data), the box with its limit, «Salvează nota» and «Renunță». Without JavaScript the control is a plain link to the registration's page at `#note-interne`. The save is a server action (`addRegistrationNoteFromListAction`): `requireStaffCapability(canKeepRegistrationNotes)`, then `addRegistrationNote`, which asserts the role again. A refusal (empty, too long, the registration erased meanwhile) is said at the box with the words still in it, the way the card's own presses say it; a success comes back to the same list address (filters, sort, page) through the list's own return for a row press (`backToList` and the hidden `listQuery`: only the query travels, the path is rebuilt, so there is no open redirect) with the existing toast «Nota a fost salvată», and the row's marker counts the new note. Nothing typed goes in the address, the toast or the trail (`registration.note_added`, empty metadata, as before). The control is one small client island, `shared/ui/RowNoteDialog.tsx`, generic by construction — the action, the hidden fields' names and values, the fallback address, the limit and every word are props — because the volunteers' list is to get the same control next; it receives strings and a Server Action reference, never an element or a component.

**Privacy.** Unchanged: the same people see the same notes, now sooner. The list still reads notes in one grouped count (the marker's), with no query per row; the dialog lists no existing note, the marker is the link to the card that reads them. A note is still in no export, email, desk or public list beyond what §777 and §785 say. No new table, no migration, no change to the privacy notice's template or any legal text.

**Decided without the owner:** that the card is open when it has notes (he asked only that it come first and that the comments «apară cumva mai sus»; open-on-arrival is what makes them read without a press, and a registration without a note keeps the closed line); that «first» means right under the heading block, above «Ce îi spui» and the verbs, not above the name; that the dialog adds a note and does not list the existing ones, so the list keeps its one grouped count; that the return after a save is the list as it stood (page included) rather than the registration's page; that the refusal is said in the dialog rather than by leaving the list; that the control stands in the name cell next to the marker rather than in the row's «⋮» menu, which is the Administrator's.

**Refused.** A query per row to show the latest note in the list (the grouped count is the list's only read of notes); listing the notes inside the dialog (the card reads them, and a second place to read them is a second place to leak them); putting the control in the «⋮» menu (an Organizer has none of its verbs, and the notes are the Organizer's); a second fold mechanism for «open when it has notes» (`openWhen` is the one); a control that works only for registrations (the volunteers' list is next, so it is generic); passing the glyph or any element from the Server Component to the island (a name or nothing, §370).
changelogLine: - **«Note interne» first, and a note from the list** — on a registration's page the notes card is the first card and opens by itself when it holds a note; every row of the registrations list has «Adaugă o notă», a dialog that saves without leaving the list and comes back to the same filters and page. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 22: Given an Organizer, an Administrator or a Superadministrator on a registration's page, when it is drawn, then «Note interne» is the first card after the page's heading block, before «Ce îi spui» and every other card, it is open on arrival exactly when the registration has at least one live note (closed with «nicio notă» when it has none, and still open after its own save or delete and for `#note-interne`), through the fold's own reason `holds`, and the Tehnic role, the volunteer and the Redactor get neither the card nor a read of the notes (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the registrations list, when a role that may keep notes reads it, then every row carries «Adaugă o notă» (at least 44 pixels high, its accessible name naming the person, beside the notes marker when the row has notes), a dialog with the person's name in its title, the help line, the box with its limit, «Salvează nota» and a cancel, and without JavaScript a link to the registration's page at `#note-interne`; the list still reads notes in one grouped count and the dialog lists no note; a role that may not keep notes sees no control (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the press «Salvează nota» from a row of the registrations list, when each of the seven roles posts it, then the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator write exactly one note and one `registration.note_added` row with empty metadata and come back to the same list address (filters, sort, page) through the list's validated return with the toast «Nota a fost salvată», every other role is refused FORBIDDEN by the coarse gate and again by the service and writes nothing, a refusal (empty, too long, a registration erased meanwhile) comes back as the form's own state with the words still in the box, and nothing typed is in the address, the toast or the trail (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Note interne» first on a registration's page, open when it has notes, and «Adaugă o notă» from a row of the list
